objective: Fresh hard external replication: GPT-5.6 Sol M0 vs independent executable verifier with at most one bounded correction per failed task.

benchmark.selection: contiguous B/C/D from official contest score table only; selected statements/editorials unopened at freeze

arms.M0: GPT-5.6 Sol one-shot implementation from official statement only; no candidate execution before all selected source hashes freeze.
arms.X1: Frozen M0 + independent executable failing evidence + at most one bounded correction per failed task.

hard_rules: No editorial, accepted submission, solution writeup, or gold code before M0 freeze.
No selected candidate execution before all M0 source hashes are frozen.
Independent verifier/reference oracle constructed only after M0 freeze.
At most one bounded correction per failed task.
Quarantine any task whose verifier cannot establish claim-grade correctness or whose complexity is not constraint-safe.
contamination_exclusions: ARC217 excluded from V30 because web search exposed statement snippets before any preregistration freeze.
